component: Calendar Fluent migration and Thunderbird document resources

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The original Calendar context migration removed conversion DTD entities while mailContext.inc.xhtml and msgHdrView.inc.xhtml still referenced them at that revision. The later accepted message-header fragment uses Fluent IDs, and its owning aboutMessage document loads calendar/calendar.ftl; about3Pane also loads that resource for included mail markup. A fragment migration must be checked with its real document consumers before calling the change behavior-neutral. This exact add/backout study does not audit the later reland or prove platform/browser behavior. No runtime or migration test ran.
title: Calendar context migration reaches mail fragments and their owning documents
